# SocialPause 0.7.2

Performance maintenance update, version code 11. Uses the existing personal-install signing identity and preserves current timers, cooldowns, lunch records, history and the six-hour Stop lock.

- Avoids serializing unchanged state; active usage retains its previous save opportunities.
- Checks confirmed unselected apps every two seconds, while selected apps and drawer-covered use retain 500 ms checks. Accessibility events still trigger immediate checks. Screen-off fallback remains thirty seconds; stopped monitoring does not poll.
- Reuses notification labels/style and skips identical builds, with one cancellation on entering Sleep Time. Preserves app icons, expanded timers, Samsung eligibility and 0.7.1 dismissal recovery.
- Reuses indexed history summaries and chart data. In synthetic emulator checks, 200 unchanged Insights refreshes dropped from 2,000 aggregations/200 chart rebuilds to zero of each after the initial display.
- UI countdowns read snapshots instead of triggering another stream of saves, notification updates and alarm work.
- Adds deterministic optimization/upgrade checks, builds the instrumentation APK in CI, and verifies instrumentation outcomes rather than trusting ADB's exit code alone.

See docs/PERFORMANCE.md and docs/VALIDATION.md for methods and results. These are emulator/JVM measurements, not Samsung battery claims. Actual One UI countdown recovery and app-entry responsiveness still require phone acceptance. A missed foreground Accessibility event can take approximately two seconds to recover from Home.

Install SocialPause.apk over the existing app; do not uninstall or clear data. Keep Sleep Time inactive when testing notifications and retain the Samsung live-notification setting that previously enabled the countdown.
